grammar.label: linkers of contrast — although, though, however, despite
grammar.form: although + clause; despite + noun/-ing; however + sentence
grammar.meaning: two facts that do not fit together

explanation.en: 'Although' and 'though' join two clauses. 'Despite' and 'in spite of' take a noun or -ing. 'However' starts a new sentence and takes a comma.
explanation.uz: 'although' va 'though' ikki gapni bog'laydi. 'despite' va 'in spite of' dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi. 'however' yangi gap boshlaydi va verguldan keyin turadi.

grammar.positive_example: Although it was raining, we walked. Despite the rain, we walked.
grammar.negative_example: Despite it was raining, we walked.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekcha 'bo'lsa ham' bir shaklga ega; ingliz tilida gap yoki ot kelishiga qarab tanlanadi.

grammar.label: linkers of reason and result — as, since, therefore, as a result
grammar.meaning: cause and consequence in more formal language

explanation.en: 'As' and 'since' introduce a reason, often at the start. 'Therefore' and 'as a result' introduce the consequence.
explanation.uz: 'as' va 'since' sababni kiritadi, ko'pincha gap boshida. 'therefore' va 'as a result' natijani kiritadi.

grammar.positive_example: Since the shop was closed, we went home.
grammar.negative_example: Since the shop was closed, therefore we went home.

l1_notes.uz: Sabab va natija bog'lovchilarini bir gapda ikki marta ishlatish keng tarqalgan xato.

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: They have offered me a place on the professional team.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: That is what you wanted. Why the long face?

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: Although the pay is better, the training is six days a week.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: So you would have to give up your course.

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: Exactly. Despite the money, that is a serious drawback.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: How long would the contract last?

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: Two years. However, most players do not last that long.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Since the course takes three years, the two do not fit together.

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: It is. For example, my exams are in the middle of the season.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Therefore you would be doing both badly, not one well.

body.speaker: Bobur
body.text: That is the biggest reason I am hesitating.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Then you have answered your own question.
